title: Kagamine Rin — Happy Anniversary!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Everyone, are you ready?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How about everybody watching the stream? Are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Let's see... “Good to go!”
And... “Let's do this!”
Alright, I think we're set!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's get Kagamine Rin & Kagamine Len's Special Anniversary Show started♪
song00001_off_f

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks for listening, everyone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That was incredible!
You two were more in sync than usual!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank goodness!
We practiced a lot just for today!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You spent quite a lot of time on your setlist too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I noticed that too. They even had a whole sheet of paper filled with ideas for their eventual setlist.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You only get one day to celebrate an anniversary each year, so we wanted to make the most of it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But we sort of got carried away and ended up writing things on the desk we were using.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I mean, we didn't have any room left on that sheet of paper, so it is what it is...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
Rin, I heard that you were doing shows even in your dreams because you were so excited.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. That's actually how I decided on a setlist for my part of the show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I kept trying to think of the best songs for this and almost didn't know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But while I was dreaming, I saw myself singing all the songs I was really hoping to sing here!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. Talk about ambitious.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But they all mean so much to me, and I'm able to sing them because of everybody that's here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So I want to sing as many of them as I can! I think that's what my dreams were telling me to do!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And for my part of the show, I'll be bringing you a special medley!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You'll get to hear song after song, so try to keep up, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know this isn't gonna be easy, you guys, but I'll be counting on you too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, don't say that. I can't wait to get started!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree! If we're not careful, some of us might jump out onto the stage even when it's not our turn.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. If that happens, we'll just have to sing together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha. Great idea!
That'll be more fun anyway!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, Rin, you ready?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Here we go!
My special anniversary show medley♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Phew... We sang so much...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem happy, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm super duper extra happy♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How about you guys? Did you all have fun?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Look at all the comments everybody left while watching the stream.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! They've been cheering in unison with everyone else!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Seeing all those comments come in at once was so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you for making this such a great show, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And that concludes my part of the show!
Next, we have...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, Rin, actually...
Your part isn't over yet.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We've prepared some special messages for you. Would you mind hearing them?
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Rin.
I can't help but smile every time I see you and Len singing together the way you do.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I hope you two stay as close as you are now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Great show, Rin!
It was really worth helping out with it considering how much fun it ended up being.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I always have fun hanging out with you, but I really hope we get another chance to do a show like this, together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin, working towards your own goals is a wonderful thing, but the effort you put into making sure everyone in the audience would enjoy this show also needs mentioning.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Truly an incredible show!
Happy anniversary, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sometimes, you do get ahead of yourself and don't get the results you were looking for...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But your bright and cheerful outlook on everything is what makes you so adorable, Rin. I hope that light never fades!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Last but not least, me!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We share the same anniversary, but it always feels like we get twice the celebration with you and everyone else around!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. So let's keep this party going and make everything as fun as possible!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Th-That's not fair...
No one told me about this...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. Of course, no one told you. It wouldn't be a secret if someone did, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So if you don't mind, we'd like to congratulate you one last time! One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Th-Thanks, you guys... I don't know what else to say!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I promise to keep putting on fun shows and singing all sorts of different songs!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I can sing these songs because of you, so I want everyone out there to hear them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Now, let's move to Len's part of the show!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Enjoy and don't forget to stick around until the end!
